title: VP spokesman’s reply to Senate order due today
summary: Vice President Sara Duterte’s spokesman Paolo Panelo has until today to explain why he should not be cited for contempt over his public remarks questioning the impartiality of senator-judges.

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte’s spokesman Paolo Panelo has until today to explain why he should not be cited for contempt over his public remarks questioning the impartiality of senator-judges.
According to Senate Secretary Renato Bantug Jr., the Senate impeachment court transmitted the show-cause order to Panelo via email on Friday.
Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian stressed that the order carried the unanimous backing of both the majority and minority blocs, urging Panelo to either apologize or justify his statements.

“It’s better for him to just apologize in order to be humble. But if he won’t do it, he should explain himself. Because he is already stepping over the line with what he is saying. And he has no basis for his claims,” he said.
